name: Integrating AO with Greedy Meshing
aliases: Greedy Meshing with AO-Aware Merge Rule
Greedy Meshing with Baked Ambient Occlusion
definition: Strategies to handle the conflict between ambient occlusion variation across individual block boundaries and the merging of coplanar, adjacent voxel faces into larger single quads in greedy meshing.
summary: Integrating AO with Greedy Meshing merges coplanar voxel faces into quads while enforcing strict visual continuity of lighting by ensuring interpolated shading accurately represents the occlusion of every unit face it replaces.
